return_001.speaker: narrator
return_001.text: Snow had settled on the repaired rail by the time Lin Yue returned to Azure Cloud. She counted the lower steps out of habit, then stopped counting when a boy overtook her carrying an empty bucket. Her own bag was light and its strap properly settled. Elder Yun's invitation had offered one afternoon after Yue's existing winter commitments, with no employment or examination attached. Yue had accepted that interval. Beyond it lay supper at the west kiln, where her mother had already asked her to bring ginger.

return_002.speaker: narrator
return_002.text: The lower terrace smelled of damp wool and the same sour ash she remembered. A new roof covered the cistern. Someone had painted a red line beside the place where she once struck her knee, and the line had worn pale beneath years of ordinary boots. Yue touched no wound that was no longer there. The shoulder that still needed care belonged to a different day. She rested at the covered bench until the bag's weight stopped reminding her of it.

return_003.speaker: narrator
return_003.text: Shen Qing came out carrying a training bowl and two chipped cups. He set the bowl down first. Yue laughed before greeting him. For several years she had imagined showing him a splendid technique upon returning; now the thing that delighted her was the ordinary care with which he protected the cups from a wet sleeve. He asked about her journey, then offered tea. He had not invited a performance. She found she could answer without producing one.

return_004.speaker: narrator
return_004.text: Yun arrived with a narrow tin box. Inside lay the original sheets from the lower terrace's first winter classes, preserved after the old cupboard was repaired. Yue recognized her own early hand before she recognized any sentence. The grounding mark on one page was thick with repeated corrections. Yun placed the box where Yue could see it without leaning. Then she opened a separate cover containing an accusation written by a recent applicant: the teachers had concealed a successful qi reading from Lin Yue.

return_005.speaker: narrator
return_005.text: The applicant had copied a line from a public teaching extract. It read, Warmth answered the stone on the third call. Below it appeared Yue's name and a date. He had taken the sentence to mean she sensed qi in her first week, and that her long ordinary preparation had been unnecessary. Yue remembered that afternoon differently. She remembered hunger, two false calls and a single coincidence. Seeing her name beneath the shortened line made the mistaken certainty feel uncomfortably personal.

return_006.speaker: narrator
return_006.text: Qing brought the complete observation sheet. It recorded three calls: two with the calibrated stone absent, one with it present. The disposition was uncertain, with repetition required after rest. The original agreed with Yue's memory but mattered independently of it. Yun laid the public extract beside the complete sheet. Its missing words were not a secret spiritual capacity. They were the conditions that had kept an ordinary observation from becoming a finding.

return_007.speaker: narrator
return_007.text: The applicant had left before the mistake was discovered. He was now working a morning shift beyond the lower gate, and a runner could offer him a meeting later. Yue asked whether he had been punished for the accusation. Qing said no. The public extract gave him a reasonable reason to question the account. He had also demanded his application fee back, which required a separate decision by its receiving clerk. Correcting a sentence would not settle a money claim by itself.

return_008.speaker: narrator
return_008.text: Yun had preserved the copying packet. The old printer's line limit had pushed the uncertainty sentence onto a continuation slip. That slip was absent from the public wrapper. The copyist's receiving note said two leaves; the cabinet now contained one leaf and an empty tie. Nobody present could say when the second leaf disappeared. Yue felt anger looking for a person to occupy. She put the feeling beside the empty tie rather than writing somebody's name into it.

return_009.speaker: narrator
return_009.text: Qing offered the afternoon's three available uses. The public extract could be corrected now from the original, before another applicant read it. The copying chain could be compared first, while the current extract was marked as disputed. Or Yue could meet the applicant and hear what he had understood before composing the correction. Yun would keep the original safe and the limited time real. Their next action could help a particular problem without solving all three at once.

return_010.speaker: narrator
return_010.text: Yue looked toward the lower gate. Beyond it lay the applicant, the printer's receiving counter and the road home. She could choose one first approach before the afternoon bell. Qing would keep the disputed extract from being issued as an unqualified teaching result while they worked. No new qi trial was needed to establish what the old trial recorded. Yue took her own private notebook from the bag and left a blank page beside the three possibilities.

return_choice.speaker: lin_yue
return_choice.text: The shortened line had given somebody an answer that her first teacher had deliberately withheld from an uncertain result. Yue wanted the complete finding to become useful again. She also wanted to know whether a missing leaf had been misplaced or deliberately taken, and whether the applicant still wished to speak with her. The afternoon could begin with one of those needs. She chose without promising that the others would disappear.

choices.text: Correct the public extract from the complete original first.
Trace the missing continuation leaf through its recorded custody.
Hear the applicant's account before drafting the explanation.

return_public_001.speaker: narrator
return_public_001.text: Yue chose the public correction. Qing fetched the original extract's authorized teaching wrapper and Yun confirmed that the complete finding could be quoted there. They retained the observation itself: one call coincided with the stone, two did not. Below it Yue copied the disposition, uncertain, followed by the requirement for a rested comparison. She wanted to add a paragraph about patience. Qing asked whether that paragraph established anything the missing sentence had not. She put it in her private notebook instead.

return_public_002.speaker: narrator
return_public_002.text: The printer's apprentice arrived to collect the corrected slip before the next class. She counted its two sides and read the final disposition aloud. Yun withdrew the old incomplete extract from the active teaching tray, retaining it within the inquiry packet. Its date and missing continuation remained visible. The new slip did not pretend the error had never been public. Yue watched the apprentice tie the wrapper firmly enough to travel and loosely enough to open without tearing it.

return_public_003.speaker: narrator
return_public_003.text: The applicant reached the terrace while they were checking the wrapper. He had accepted the runner's offered interval and came with flour on his cuffs. Qing showed him the full sheet and the correction. The young man read slowly, then asked why nobody had shown him that version before he complained. Yue answered that the public copy had been incomplete. She did not ask him to be grateful that the original was now available. He had already lost a morning arguing from the page they supplied.

return_public_004.speaker: narrator
return_public_004.text: He agreed to let the correction record that a reader's question exposed the omission, without publishing his name or his application dispute. He declined a longer conversation with Yue today. His shift had ended late and the person lending him a room expected him back before dark. The refusal left Yue with something she had not anticipated: the useful public work was complete, while the person it had helped wanted to go elsewhere.

return_public_005.speaker: narrator
return_public_005.text: The receiving clerk gave him the channel for his fee claim and accepted the corrected extract as a supporting document. She promised a dated reply, not a refund at this table. He took that acknowledgment and left. Yue had no authority to decide the money. She could make sure the question survived departure without letting the printed correction become a receipt for something that had not been paid.

return_public_006.speaker: narrator
return_public_006.text: At the last available bell, the printer's apprentice brought the corrected first copy for checking. Its uncertainty sentence was on the same side as the three observations. The original's disposition and the copy agreed. Qing approved its teaching use under that exact scope. The missing continuation's custody still had no established answer. Yue could feel the unsolved question beside the finished correction, and leave both visible.

return_source_001.speaker: narrator
return_source_001.text: Yue chose the copying chain. Yun put a disputed-result cover around the active extract before they left the terrace table. It preserved access to the complete original through Qing, while warning that the shortened line did not establish a successful qi finding. Yue carried only the permitted copying references to the printer's public counter. Qing carried no old examination sheet outside its cupboard. The walk to the counter was dry, short and within her ordinary shoulder arrangements.

return_source_002.speaker: narrator
return_source_002.text: The printer compared the receiving note with his own job book. Two leaves had been set, checked and sent back under one reference. He retained a proof of the second leaf containing the uncertainty disposition. It explained what had been printed, but did not establish who later removed it from the teaching wrapper. Yue asked for the delivery acknowledgment. The printer pointed to the archive's numbered receipt and showed where its copy was bound into his book.

return_source_003.speaker: narrator
return_source_003.text: An old repair entry placed the teaching packet in temporary storage during a roof leak. Its transfer count described one bound wrapper rather than the leaves inside it. The receiving custodian had signed for that wrapper without an internal inventory. The records carried the packet across the repair but could not establish its contents at each handover. Yue wanted to find a decisive gap with a decisive person beside it. Instead she found a limitation that belonged to the way several careful people had counted.

return_source_004.speaker: narrator
return_source_004.text: The current custodian opened the dry cabinet under her own permission. A loose continuation slip lay between two unrelated exercise folders, with the matching printer reference on its edge. Its words agreed with the retained proof. She recorded where she found it before returning it to Yun's packet. Finding the leaf established its present place and restored the teaching material. It did not establish how it had arrived behind those folders.

return_source_005.speaker: narrator
return_source_005.text: The applicant accepted the runner's invitation but reached the counter after the afternoon's copying interval had closed. Yue showed him the restored disposition and explained the custody limit. He asked whether the teachers would now blame the roof workers. She said the record did not support that accusation. He asked about his fee. Qing arranged the receiving clerk's ordinary claim channel, leaving its decision open. The young man had spent a second journey obtaining words that should have travelled with the first page.

return_source_006.speaker: narrator
return_source_006.text: At the terrace, Yun approved a corrected extract with the disposition on the observation's own side. The restored loose slip remained in the preserved inquiry packet, with its finding place recorded. Yue had learned where it was, not who displaced it. The printer could prepare the next teaching copies under the normal schedule. Until they arrived, Qing would show applicants the complete finding himself. The afternoon had supplied provenance and a delay, and its record kept both.

return_listener_001.speaker: narrator
return_listener_001.text: Yue chose to hear the applicant. Qing covered the incomplete extract with its disputed-result notice and remained available to show the original. The runner returned with an accepted meeting interval after the young man's shift. Yue waited at the supported bench rather than going into the workshop to fetch him sooner. The afternoon light reached the worn red line beside the cistern. She had once waited here wanting somebody to notice how hard she was trying.

return_listener_002.speaker: narrator
return_listener_002.text: He arrived with a paper folded until its corners had gone soft. It was his mother's account of the coins they had spent on travel, meals and the application. She had copied the list twice because he kept losing the first version. He offered to let Yue read it privately, then said he did not want it attached to his accusation. She read it under that boundary. The incomplete teaching extract had suggested a shortcut to a household that could barely afford the long path.

return_listener_003.speaker: narrator
return_listener_003.text: He had believed the teachers concealed success to keep applicants doing paid terrace work. The fuller observation sheet changed that belief, but not his concern about being able to eat while attending lessons. Yue told him what her old wage arrangement had actually covered. She gave him no promise that his current offer matched it. Qing fetched the present task and class notice. The young man read its hours before its cultivation language.

return_listener_004.speaker: narrator
return_listener_004.text: The available morning work conflicted with two of the classes he most wanted. Qing could accept a request to review the timetable, but could not invent another funded shift today. The applicant decided to keep his current job while asking for an examination date he could attend after proper preparation. He would also pursue the fee question through the receiving clerk. Hearing a person carefully had not produced the money needed to make every useful choice available.

return_listener_005.speaker: narrator
return_listener_005.text: Yue drafted an explanation that retained the three observed calls and their uncertain disposition. At his request she added where a reader could inspect the complete teaching finding. She left out his mother, her coins and his private fear of another unsuccessful winter. He checked the explanation for the claim he had actually made. He permitted the correction to credit an unnamed reader's question, and took his household paper home.

return_listener_006.speaker: narrator
return_listener_006.text: The printer's collection interval had already passed. Yun approved the wording, and Qing placed the complete finding beside the disputed extract for the remaining afternoon. Fresh teaching copies would follow the next ordinary collection. Yue's selected conversation had changed the explanation and helped the applicant make a real request. It had not recovered the missing leaf or delivered the corrected print run today. She entered those limits before packing her private notebook.

return_public_close.speaker: narrator
return_public_close.text: At the afternoon bell, Yun filed the checked correction and left the missing-leaf inquiry open. The applicant's money claim had its own acknowledged channel. Yue took ginger from the market on her way home, carrying no copy of his private papers. She had restored a usable public finding quickly, and had not earned the longer conversation she wanted. The old uncertain result remained uncertain. Under the repaired rail, another student waited with a plain hemp tablet and enough of the right words to ask a better question.
return_public_close.ending: The Finding Returned to Its Readers

return_source_close.speaker: narrator
return_source_close.text: Yun put the recovered continuation beside its recorded finding place and the matching printer proof. The current teaching finding was complete; responsibility for the old displacement remained unestablished. The applicant's second journey and pending fee question stayed in their separate records. Yue bought ginger before the shop closed. She could carry home the pleasure of finding a missing page without pretending she had found a culprit. The unanswered part remained an honest question somebody could examine later.
return_source_close.ending: A Leaf Found Without a Culprit

return_listener_close.speaker: narrator
return_listener_close.text: Yun retained the approved explanation and the next printer collection date. Qing would keep the complete finding available meanwhile. The applicant left with his household paper, his chosen timetable request and the clerk's fee acknowledgment. Yue walked toward the ginger shop thinking of her mother's old grain calculations. Her attention had helped one conversation and delayed the printed correction. The book could keep both consequences, while the young man kept the parts of his winter he had chosen never to publish.
return_listener_close.ending: The Conversation and the Waiting Print
